verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that LlamaCloud, including LlamaParse and LlamaExtract, can be deployed entirely within your own infrastructure (self-hosted/BYOC) with full platform capabilities. Deployment runs on Kubernetes via Helm charts on AWS, Azure or GCP, and the enterprise-readiness page lists self-hosting alongside managed SaaS. The community comments about a proprietary hosted service are general criticism and do not contradict that self-hosting exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and clarity on access or licensing terms (e.g. whether self-hosting is limited to Enterprise contracts).
